# Yakima Valley Farm Workers Clinic

> Comprehensive healthcare network serving farm workers and families across the Yakima Valley with medical, dental, behavioral health, and specialty services.

Yakima Valley Farm Workers Clinic operates multiple clinics and health centers throughout Washington's Yakima Valley region, providing integrated primary care, dental services, behavioral health, women's health, pediatrics, and community programs with bilingual support and insurance flexibility for underserved agricultural communities.

## Key Topics

- Primary Care
- Family Medicine
- Behavioral Health
- Medical-Dental Services
- Women's Health
- Pediatrics
- WIC Program
- Bilingual Services
- Medicaid & Medicare
- Farm Workers
- Yakima Valley
- Urgent Care
- Mental Health
- Community Programs
- MyChart Patient Portal

## Main Hub

- [Home - Yakima Valley Farm Workers Clinic](https://www.yvfwc.com): Homepage for Yakima Valley Farm Workers Clinic with family healthcare services
- [Clinics - Yakima Valley Farm Workers Clinic](https://www.yvfwc.com/locations): Directory of all Yakima Valley Farm Workers Clinic locations

## Medical & Dental Clinics

- [11th Avenue Family Medicine Clinic - Yakima Valley Farm Workers Clinic](https://www.yvfwc.com/locations/11th-avenue-family-medicine-clinic): 11th Avenue Family Medicine Clinic location with primary care services
- [Yakima Medical-Dental Clinic - Yakima Valley Farm Workers Clinic](https://www.yvfwc.com/locations/yakima-medical-dental-clinic): Yakima Medical-Dental Clinic with comprehensive medical and dental services
- [Lincoln Avenue Medical-Dental Center - Yakima Valley Farm Workers Clinic](https://www.yvfwc.com/locations/lincoln-avenue-medical-dental-center): Lincoln Avenue clinic offering medical-dental services and women's health
- [Toppenish Medical-Dental Clinic - Yakima Valley Farm Workers Clinic](https://www.yvfwc.com/locations/toppenish-medical-dental-clinic): Toppenish Medical-Dental Clinic with comprehensive medical and dental services
- [Grandview Medical-Dental Clinic - Yakima Valley Farm Workers Clinic](https://www.yvfwc.com/locations/grandview-medical-dental-clinic): Grandview Medical-Dental Clinic with comprehensive health and dental services
- [Mid-Valley Family Medicine - Yakima Valley Farm Workers Clinic](https://www.yvfwc.com/locations/mid-valley-family-medicine): Mid-Valley Family Medicine in Wapato offering primary care and pediatrics
- [Granger Family Medicine Clinic - Yakima Valley Farm Workers Clinic](https://www.yvfwc.com/locations/granger-family-medicine-clinic): Granger Family Medicine Clinic providing primary care in Granger, Washington
- [Sunnyside Immediate Care - Yakima Valley Farm Workers Clinic](https://www.yvfwc.com/locations/sunnyside-immediate-care): Sunnyside Immediate Care providing urgent care and family medicine services

## Specialty & Behavioral Health Services

- [Behavioral Health Services - Yakima Valley Farm Workers Clinic](https://www.yvfwc.com/locations/behavioral-health-services): Behavioral health services including substance use disorder treatment
- [Behavioral Health Services - Mead - Yakima Valley Farm Workers Clinic](https://www.yvfwc.com/locations/behavioral-health-services-mead): Behavioral health services in Mead with mental health and psychiatric care
- [West Valley Family Health & OB/GYN - Yakima Valley Farm Workers Clinic](https://www.yvfwc.com/locations/west-valley-family-health-ob-gyn): West Valley clinic specializing in family health and obstetrics/gynecology
- [Mountainview Women's Health Center - Yakima Valley Farm Workers Clinic](https://www.yvfwc.com/locations/mountainview-womens-health-center): Mountainview Women's Health Center in Grandview specializing in women's health

## Pediatrics & Family Programs

- [Children's Village - Yakima Valley Farm Workers Clinic](https://www.yvfwc.com/locations/childrens-village): Children's Village pediatric clinic with dental and behavioral health services
- [Memorial WIC - Yakima Valley Farm Workers Clinic](https://www.yvfwc.com/locations/memorial-wic): Memorial WIC program providing nutrition benefits for pregnant and postpartum

## Dental Services

- [YV Tech Dental - Yakima Valley Farm Workers Clinic](https://www.yvfwc.com/locations/yv-tech-dental): YV Tech Dental providing family dentistry services in Yakima Valley
- [Community Dental Care - Yakima Valley Farm Workers Clinic](https://www.yvfwc.com/locations/community-dental-care): Community Dental Care in Sunnyside offering family dentistry services

## Community Centers & Support Programs

- [Northwest Community Action Center - Yakima Valley Farm Workers Clinic](https://www.yvfwc.com/locations/northwest-community-action-center): Northwest Community Action Center in Toppenish offering education and housing
- [Safe Haven - Yakima Valley Farm Workers Clinic](https://www.yvfwc.com/locations/safe-haven): Safe Haven Community Center in Toppenish with youth and adult programs
